findings.current: Perhaps that was why the scouts stood frozen for a moment before they noticed the two knots tied at the beggar’s waist.
findings.defect: The Korean says the scouts noticed the knots belatedly after freezing like statues. “Before they noticed” gives the sequence but omits that they realized it late.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly uses 뒤늦게 (belatedly) for their discovery.
findings.replacement: Perhaps that was why the scouts, frozen like statues for an instant, only belatedly noticed the two knots tied at the beggar’s waist.

findings.current: Then, in the suffocating silence that pressed down on them all, his body tilted. His difficult journey had come to an end.
findings.defect: The source says his body tilted accompanied by a faint voice. The assembled English omits that detail.
findings.rationale: 흐릿한 목소리와 함께 directly links the faint voice to the disciple’s body tilting.
findings.replacement: Then, in the suffocating silence that pressed down on them all, his body tilted with a faint voice. His difficult journey had come to an end.

summary: The translation is largely faithful, with two minor omissions of source details.
